# TMs and HMs

Hoenn's TMs and HMs are Black 2's items. Black 2 numbers its TMs differently, so a Gen 3 TM is the Black 2 TM that teaches the same move. The nine Gen 3 TM moves Black 2 has no TM for have their own new TMs, TM96 to TM104. Every Pokémon that could learn the Gen 3 TM can learn the new one.

## Field moves without HMs

Obstacles are still there, but you don't have to teach an HM. As in Ruby and Sapphire, a field move needs its Hoenn badge; then either a Pokémon that knows the move or the move's TM/HM in your Bag is enough.

| Move | Item in the Bag | Badge |
|---|---|---|
| Cut | HM01 Cut | Stone Badge |
| Flash | TM70 Flash | Knuckle Badge |
| Rock Smash | TM94 Rock Smash | Dynamo Badge |
| Strength | HM04 Strength | Heat Badge |
| Surf | HM03 Surf | Balance Badge |
| Fly | HM02 Fly | Feather Badge |
| Dive | HM06 Dive | Mind Badge |
| Waterfall | HM05 Waterfall | Rain Badge |
